'''Wyatt Evertt''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Phoenix Mega Tournament (4 November)]] on 4 November 2000 with Endor speeder mike drains, according to Charles Hickey's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1457">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-13-phoenix-az-mega-tournyd1457/ phoenix-az-mega-tourny], DeckTech (Charles "Teacher" Hickey, 13 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-13-phoenix-az-mega-tournyd1457/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
